name: Louder ESP32 two-way (tas58xx crossover fork)
notes: Sonocotta Louder ESP32-S3 (TAS5805M) driving a two-way cabinet through github.com/craigmillard86/esphome-tas58xx@crossover. Tweeter on one output, mid/bass on the other, passive radiators. Expose all six PEQ bands per driver in the device YAML to use the full fit.
